info.title: Campus Köthen API
info.description:
Public read-only API of the Campus Köthen app.

Campus Köthen is an independent, unofficial campus app. It is neither developed
nor operated by Hochschule Anhalt, nor is it officially endorsed by the university.

All content endpoints accept `locale=de|en` (default `de`) and report
`requestedLocale`, `resolvedLocale` and `translationFallback` in their metadata.
Canteen dish text comes from a German-only source and is never machine-translated.

tags.name: public-calendars
tags.description: Public Google calendars (read-only, synced via public ICS)

iconKey.description: Semantic key, not a client class name.

defaultSubscribed.description: Applied by the client exactly once, when the slug first appears.

translationFallback.description: True when at least one delivered field came from the German fallback although another locale was requested.

droppedBlockTypes.description: Content block types removed because the MVP client does not render them.

lastSuccessfulSyncAt.description: Last successful canteen synchronisation. Null means: never succeeded.

dataStale.description: True when the data is older than the configured threshold.

from.description: Start of the resolved date range (YYYY-MM-DD).

to.description: End of the resolved date range (YYYY-MM-DD).

featureEnabled.description: False when the timetable integration is switched off server-side.

dataState.description: ready = data present; pending = enabled but not yet synchronised; unavailable = disabled or permanently without data.

timezone.description: Business timezone the wall-clock times belong to.

sourceUrl.description: Validated https URL of the original source, or null.

content.description: Sanitised content blocks, delivered with the LIST entry so a feed can render the article inline without a request per card. Only paragraph, heading, list, quote and image survive; anything else is removed server-side and reported in meta.droppedBlockTypes.

sourceUrl.description: Validated https URL of the original source, or null.

content.description: Sanitised content blocks, delivered with the LIST entry so a feed can render the article inline without a request per card. Only paragraph, heading, list, quote and image survive; anything else is removed server-side and reported in meta.droppedBlockTypes.

personCount.description: Zero is a valid, fully supported state — an area needs no contact person.

isDemoContent.description: True for seed data that has not been cleared for publication.

descriptionText.description: The sanitised long description as PLAIN TEXT. A search matches words, not formatting; links contribute their label, images nothing.

rooms.description: Rooms of the demo campus map. An empty list is normal — a contact needs no room.

description.description: Sanitised content blocks, same rules as news content.

persons.description: Active persons only; may be empty.

rooms.description: Rooms of the demo campus map. An empty list is normal — an area needs no room.

displayName.description: API-owned text, available in de and en.

lastSuccessfulSyncAt.description: Null means the canteen has never synchronised successfully.

dataStale.description: True when the data is older than the configured threshold.

displayName.description: API-owned text, available in de and en.

label.description: German label from the source — never machine-translated.

kind.description: The source mixes both namespaces inside one array, so the distinction is preserved here.

group.description: Stable technical key. The client highlights "student".

amount.description: Decimal STRING with fixed scale — never a float, to avoid rounding.

sourceLanguage.description: Always "de": the upstream source publishes German only and is not translated.

markers.description: Everything the source declared, including codes with no semantic meaning to this API.

traits.description: Stable semantic properties of the dish, derived from the source. Filter on these, never on marker codes or labels.

allergens.description: Declared allergens as stable keys. A subtype (e.g. "gluten_wheat") always comes with its parent ("gluten"). A marker the API cannot classify appears in `markers` only and never gets an invented key.

prices.description: All groups the source provided. A missing group is absent, never estimated.

meals.description: An empty array is a real day without meals, not a loading failure.

days.description: Every day of the requested range.

shortName.description: Name as published by the source. Never translated.

timezone.description: Business timezone the source schedules in.

title.description: Subject name from the source. Never translated.

type.description: Normalised. An unrecognised upstream value becomes `unknown`.

status.description: Normalised. The client must render `unknown` neutrally rather than guess.

entries.description: Empty means a genuinely free day, not a loading failure.

days.description: Every day of the requested range.

googleOpenUrl.description: Safe HTTPS link to open this calendar in Google Calendar.

url.description: A calendar.google.com embed URL for the selected calendars.

roomType.description: Stable technical key; the client renders a localised label.

mapVersion.description: Version of the map catalogue this room belongs to.
